Judgment default: the TS threshold is $250m in the aggregate; the CA tests each final judgment separately (any final judgment above $250m), adds a 60-day stay/bond period and drops the TS wording 'regardless of any deductible and whether or not the insurer has been notified', which narrows the trigger (borrower favourable). Cross-default adds a further 5 Business Day grace, a waiver/cure rescission and counts only Borrower debt (borrower favourable). Against that, the CA adds an invalidity EoD (7.01(j)), makes failure to cash collateralize LCs when due an immediate payment default (not in TS item 1), and uses a Material Subsidiary test that captures Pool Asset holders (lender favourable).
